title: Design System: SEP · Tiểu học Phạm Công Bình

error-red.note: Hard-coded in CSS; a second red beside danger-ink.

headline.purpose: Screen title in the top bar; 18px/26px below 900px.

title.purpose: Section titles on detail and form screens.

nav.purpose: Rail items and underline tabs; 600 when active.

table-head.purpose: List-table column heads in rail blue.

hint.purpose: Field hints, errors, grid-input labels, due flags.

shadows.name: dialog-lift
shadows.purpose: Modal dialogs, over a rgba(20, 61, 107, .35) backdrop.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Focus state on fields and textareas (--sep-focus-ring).

motion.name: transition
motion.purpose: All color, background and border state changes (--sep-transition).

motion.name: shimmer
motion.purpose: Skeleton rows while loading; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Rail forced to 72px icon-only; toolbar stacks; tables scroll; pager unsticks; fields to 1 column.

breakpoints.name: medium
breakpoints.purpose: Field grid 4 to 2 columns; context grid 5 to 3 columns.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action of a page or toolbar, e.g. Tạo ma trận, Xác nhận ma trận.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn ds-btn-primary">Tạo ma trận <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; min-width: 100px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; font: 600 14px/20px 'Inter', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--pcb-color-bg-accent, #2f6fb0); color: #fff; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--pcb-color-bg-accent-hover, #28619c); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--pcb-color-bg-accent-active, #225585); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4a90e2; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: An alternative action beside the primary one.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 44px; min-width: 100px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid #4a90e2; background: #fff; color: #2f6fb0; font: 600 14px/20px 'Inter', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #eaf2fb; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: #dde9f7; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4a90e2; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: A destructive or refusing action (Từ chối, Xoá), kept distinct from Cancel.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 44px; min-width: 100px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 10px; border: 0; background: #fff; color: #b3403f; font: 600 14px/20px 'Inter', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: #fdf3f3; } .ds-btn-danger:active { background: #f9e7e7; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4a90e2; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Label-above field with a hairline control and a focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; } .ds-label { font: 500 14px/20px 'Inter', sans-serif; color: #26364a; } .ds-control { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #dce6f0; border-radius: 10px; background: #fff; color: #44566c; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-control:hover:not(:focus-within) { border-color: #c3d6ea; } .ds-control:focus-within { border-color: #4a90e2; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(74, 144, 226, .32); } .ds-control input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; font: 400 14px/20px 'Inter', sans-serif; color: #26364a; } .ds-control input::placeholder { color: #5d6d80; }

components.name: Rail Navigation
components.description: Solid blue rail; the active item is a white pill merged into the page by two concave corners.
components.html: Tổng quanMa trận đềNhiệm vụ đã giao
components.css: .ds-rail { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; width: 264px; padding: 24px 0 24px 16px; box-sizing: border-box; background: #2f6fb0; } .ds-nav { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 20px 0 0 20px; color: #fff; font: 500 15px/22px 'Inter', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-nav:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .12); } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: -4px; } .ds-nav-active, .ds-nav-active:hover { z-index: 1; background: #fff; color: #2f6fb0; font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-active::before, .ds-nav-active::after { content: ''; position: absolute; right: 0; width: 20px; height: 20px; pointer-events: none; } .ds-nav-active::before { top: -20px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 0 0, transparent 19.5px, #fff 20px); } .ds-nav-active::after { bottom: -20px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 0 100%, transparent 19.5px, #fff 20px); }

components.name: Underline Tabs
components.description: Status tabs that share the full width equally, with a 2px rail-blue underline on the active tab.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; border-bottom: 1px solid #dce6f0; } .ds-tab { position: relative; flex: 1; height: 46px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #44566c; font: 500 15px/22px 'Inter', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #26364a; background: #f7fafd; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4a90e2; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-tab-active, .ds-tab-active:hover { color: #2f6fb0; font-weight: 600; background: transparent; } .ds-tab-active::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 8%; right: 8%; bottom: -1px; height: 2px; border-radius: 2px 2px 0 0; background: #2f6fb0; }

components.name: Status Pills
components.description: Workflow status as soft pills: draft, assigned, submitted, approved, archived.
components.html: Nháp Đã giao Đã nộp Đã duyệt Đã lưu trữ
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 999px; font: 500 13px/20px 'Inter', sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; background: #f1f6fc; color: #44566c; } .ds-status-assigned { background: #eaf4ff; color: #2f6fb0; } .ds-status-submitted { background: #fdf8ec; color: #7a5a1e; } .ds-status-approved { background: #ecf7ef; color: #2b6b3f; } .ds-status-archived { background: #f1f0f4; color: #555061; }

components.name: Pager
components.description: List footer: rows-per-page on the left, numbered 32px squares on the right.
components.html: Hiển thị 10 bản ghi / trang Tổng 44 ma trận
components.css: .ds-pager { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px 20px; padding: 12px 0; border-top: 1px solid #dce6f0; background: #fff; font: 400 14px/20px 'Inter', sans-serif; color: #44566c; } .ds-pager-total { margin-left: 12px; padding-left: 12px; border-left: 1px solid #dce6f0; } .ds-pages { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-page { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; min-width: 32px; height: 32px; padding: 0 6px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: #26364a; font: 500 14px/20px 'Inter', sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-page:hover { background: #eaf2fb; color: #2f6fb0; } .ds-page:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4a90e2; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-page-active, .ds-page-active:hover { background: #2f6fb0; color: #fff; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Read-only Field
components.description: A label-above value on a tint-panel fill, used on detail screens.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-readfield { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; } .ds-readfield .ds-label { font: 500 14px/20px 'Inter', sans-serif; color: #26364a; } .ds-readvalue { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; margin: 0; padding: 10px 14px; box-sizing: border-box; border: 1px solid #dce6f0; border-radius: 10px; background: #f1f6fc; font: 500 14px/22px 'Inter', sans-serif; color: #26364a; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
This is a school office's working ledger, set on a computer. A solid blue rail holds the school's navigation. The screen that is open is cut out of that rail in the page's own white, so the selected item runs straight into the sheet. The sheet stays plain white: no tinted canvas, no floating cards. Hairline rules, brand-blue column heads and soft tinted pills give the page its structure. Density suits people who scan rows of assignments at a desk: 14px body, tabular figures, a numbered row index, and one quiet action column.

The palette comes from the team's Figma variables (`--pcb-*`, `--sep-*` in `src/styles/tokens.css`), and Inter is the only typeface. Both are brand commitments, not choices made on this surface. The system has one accent, the rail blue, used for the rail, primary actions, active tabs, table heads and the current page number. Status gets a small set of soft color fields, and red appears only for danger and overdue dates.

The build rejects the earlier stack of floating cards on a tinted canvas with boxed, labeled filters. The sheet is one surface, and grouping comes from rules and tints rather than from lifted containers.
keyCharacteristics: Solid rail-blue navigation with a white active pill and two concave corners that merge it into the page.
White sheet, 1px hairlines, no canvas tint behind content.
Full-width underline tabs, a one-row search-and-filter toolbar, and the primary action at the far right.
Unframed list tables with brand-blue bold heads. The matrix grid is the one framed panel, with tinted head cells.
Soft status pills that are scannable without being loud. An overdue date turns red and carries a "Quá hạn" flag.
10px radius on controls, 6px on pagination squares, 12px on panels and dialogs.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Rail blue is the only saturated hue that does not signal status. Anything that needs attention and is not a status or a danger uses rail blue or nothing.

rules.name: The Status Field Rule
rules.body: Workflow status always appears as a soft pill: amber means it waits on someone else, green means done, blue means in progress, gray means shelved, and neutral means draft. Never show status as bare colored text.

rules.name: The Overdue Rule
rules.body: Only an overdue due date turns red. It stays in its column in danger-ink and carries a "Quá hạn" flag with an icon. The row is never tinted red.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Table cells, read-only values and pager numbers set `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`. Counts, percentages and dates must line up down a column.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: Nothing that sits on the page casts a shadow. A shadow means the surface floats above the page and will close.

dos: **Do** take every color from `src/styles/tokens.css`. The palette and Inter are the team's Figma commitments.
**Do** mark the current screen with the white rail pill and its concave corners, and nothing else.
**Do** use rail-blue 600 heads, a 56px STT column and a shrink-to-fit icon column on list tables.
**Do** show workflow status only through the soft status pills, and overdue dates through the red date plus the "Quá hạn" flag.
**Do** use 44px controls on forms, 40px in toolbars, and 34px for row actions and small buttons.
**Do** keep the pager sticky at the bottom on desktop so paging works without scrolling.
**Do** show Figma features that are not built yet as disabled or inert with a "Sắp có" title, never as working controls.
donts: **Don't** put a tinted canvas behind the sheet or float shadowed cards on it. Group content with hairlines and tint-panel.
**Don't** use a shadow on anything that sits on the page. Shadows are for menus and dialogs only.
**Don't** introduce a second accent hue, or reuse the red of the StarMath reference screenshots.
**Don't** tint whole rows for status or lateness.
**Don't** make a destructive button look like the neutral button beside it.
